remarks: This charming 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath Cape Cod-style home has been thoughtfully updated from top to bottom. Step inside to discover freshly painted interiors, refinished hardwood floors, and a brand-new kitchen boasting modern cabinets, countertops, sleek appliances, stylish hardware, and new flooring. Both bathrooms have been fully renovated with contemporary finishes. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing, and the adjoining dining area is ideal for gatherings.  Additional highlights include an attached 1-car garage, a generous backyard, and abundant storage space in the lower level. With numerous updates and upgrades throughout, this home is move-in ready and designed for comfortable living!
